verdict.rationale: Skyvern has a public pricing page (skyvern-docs-13), and its docs mention choosing a plan, tracking credits and setting organization limits (skyvern-docs-43), so credit-based pricing exists. None of the evidence shows actual per-task or per-browser-hour prices, or documented rate or concurrency limits. Missing for 10: concrete per-task/per-hour price figures, a credit-to-run conversion, documented API rate limits, documented concurrent-browser limits, and independent corroboration.
